scope: Requested Arizona commercial-builder targets rejected under the requirement for project evidence, a current relevant Arizona/local official-company decision-maker, and a suitable public official-domain email. No email was guessed or inferred.

records.projectEvidence: DPR states it is currently constructing the high-performing, liquid-cooled 48MW data center in Goodyear.
records.officialDecisionMaker: Gretchen Kinsella, Southwest Self-Perform Work Leader, Phoenix, AZ
records.rejectionReason: Rejected: DPR's official press-room email is pr@dpr.com, a media address expressly excluded by the task. No suitable public official-domain email for an Arizona/local decision-maker was located on the official pages checked.
records.personalizationSentence: DPR's active 48MW liquid-cooled Goodyear data center would otherwise be a highly relevant mission-critical coordination opportunity.

records.projectEvidence: The April 2025 report identifies local general contractor Haydon at the topping-out of the 36MW Mesa data center.
records.rejectionReason: Rejected: the official material checked exposed payroll@haydon.com and hr@haydon.com only; those are payroll/HR addresses, not suitable outreach contacts. No relevant named current Arizona/local decision-maker paired with a suitable public email was found.
records.personalizationSentence: Haydon's role on the 36MW Edged Phoenix data center makes its Arizona mission-critical work relevant, but the public-contact requirement was not met.

records.project: Hartford Sylvia Encinas Elementary School rebuild
records.projectEvidence: Construction on the approximately $42M Chandler replacement campus was set to start in February 2026, with completion scheduled for January 2028.
records.officialDecisionMaker: Todd Steffen, President of CORE's Arizona Operations
records.rejectionReason: Rejected: CORE's official site identifies the Arizona operations leader, but the official pages checked do not display a suitable public contact email. The careers-page domain notice is not a public outreach address.
records.personalizationSentence: CORE's scheduled Hartford Sylvia Encinas Elementary rebuild in Chandler would otherwise be a strong campus utilities, site, and construction-phase engineering conversation.

records.companyName: Lease Crutcher Lewis / GCON joint venture
records.project: 72MW Data Center (project name not publicly disclosed)
records.projectEvidence: The official Lewis update says JV crews set first precast panels on April 2, 2025 for the future 72MW, 445,000-SF Waddell data center and will perform site work and underground utilities.
records.officialDecisionMaker: Gabe Gavriilidis, VP | Mission Critical, GCON
records.rejectionReason: Rejected: the official GCON contact page provides a form and phone rather than a public email, while Lewis's published addresses are general-inquiries or public-relations inboxes and do not establish a direct public email route to the named Arizona JV decision-maker. The joint venture therefore does not meet all contact requirements.
records.personalizationSentence: The JV's Waddell 72MW data center—already moving into precast, site-work, and underground-utilities execution—would otherwise be an unusually relevant mission-critical prospect.
